MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The basic Fire TV Stick feels useful because it would add streaming to the Samsung TV I already use alongside a DVD player.",
    "Connecting a new device to equipment I already own fits my habit of buying accessories with a specific practical purpose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and smart plug assume I want Alexa or home automation, but I have no current task that calls for either.",
    "The Echo Show displays would overlap with my tablet without solving a new need for me.",
    "The 4K streaming stick offers display capabilities my listed 720p TV cannot use, so I would choose the basic stick this time.",
    "Echo Auto shares a car setting with my GPS accessories, but my purchases addressed mounting and power connections rather than voice assistance."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in many other Amazon devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been interpreted as broad interest in smart devices rather than purchases tied to particular equipment needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, card holders, a card reader, tripods, and a lens cap suggest ongoing camera and storage needs.",
    "The exact connection or fit matters to me: my history includes device-specific charging cables, a tablet case, and a precisely sized lens cap.",
    "I often buy additions that make existing equipment more useful, so a clear purpose matters more than sharing a brand or being another electronic device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The basic streaming stick fits my existing TV setup, but most suggestions mistake my practical accessory shopping for interest in Alexa devices."
}
